info.title: Spotting Credible Tinnitus Help
info.subtitle: How to separate real care from miracle-cure marketing

rows.title: Doubt cure claims
rows.desc: No product silences all tinnitus for good.

rows.title: Check the author
rows.desc: Look for a named clinician or trusted body.

rows.title: Spot urgency tactics
rows.desc: Countdown timers and 'buy now' are red flags.

rows.title: Know real options
rows.desc: Sound therapy and counseling have support.

rows.title: Ask an audiologist
rows.desc: Confirm what you read before you spend.
